ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended
by changing all the Residential Planned Development Number 793 symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 2-J in the area bounded by:

West Grenshaw Street; South St. Louis Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel
to West Grenshaw Street; and a line 272.5 feet west of South St. Louis Avenue,

to those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District which is hereby
established in the area above.

SECTION 3. This ordinance shall be in full force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

APPLICANT: Alderwoman Monique Scott (24 Ward)
ADDRESS: 3513-3527 West Grenshaw Street; 1134-1142 South St. Louis Avenue
DATE INTRODUCED: September 13, 2023
